misses.description: 3.1.3: setpt variant planted: Trim and respond logic resets the duct static pressure setpoint between a minimum of 0.15 in. w.c. and a maximum of 2.2 in. w.c., with an initial value of 1 in. w.c..
3.2.6: setpt variant planted: VAV-205 is scheduled for 400 cfm cooling maximum, 50 cfm minimum and 200 cfm heating maximum.
3.2.3: contra variant planted: The heating valve may stay open at minimum position while the cooling valve modulates, to limit overcooling.
3.2.1: contra variant planted: The hot water supply temperature setpoint is 140 °F with outdoor air at 20 °F or colder and resets linearly to 180 °F with outdoor air at 60 °F or warmer.
3.5.1: alarm variant planted: The duct smoke detector is hardwired to stop the supply fan and close the outdoor air damper.
3.1.5: contra variant planted: With the supply fan proven on, a PI loop modulates fan speed to hold supply airflow at the scheduled design airflow.
3.2.3: setpt variant planted: The maximum supply air temperature setpoint is reset by trim and respond logic within the range 12.8 °C to 19.4 °C.
3.5.1: interlock variant planted: The BAS monitors the freeze-stat and stops the supply and return fans through their start/stop commands when it trips.
3.5.4: paragraph left out of the submittal
3.3.2: contra variant planted: Pump speed modulates to hold pump discharge pressure at a fixed 124 kPa (18 psi).
3.4.1: interlock variant planted: The BAS closes the cooling valve through its command when the condensate overflow switch trips and sets a Level 3 alarm.
3.4.2: alarm variant planted: A fan status that disagrees with the command for 15 seconds closes both valves.
3.1.3: contra variant planted: Outside scheduled hours the unit runs continuously at minimum speed to hold the unoccupied setpoints.
3.4.3: setpt variant planted: Minimum outdoor air damper position is interpolated linearly from 15 percent at minimum fan speed to 18 percent at maximum fan speed.
3.2.11: setpt variant planted: VAV-410 is scheduled for 472 L/s cooling maximum, 57 L/s minimum and 236 L/s heating maximum.
3.3.1: contra variant planted: As the cooling loop rises from 0 to 100 percent, the airflow setpoint falls from the maximum cooling airflow to the minimum.

3.4.1: setpt variant planted: Stage 1: when supply air temperature stays below 35 °F for 5 minutes, the controller sends two heating hot water plant requests, holds the outdoor air damper at minimum position and modulates the heating coil to maintain at least 42 °F; stage 1 ends after the supply air temperature is above 45 °F for 5 minutes.

3.4.3: contra variant planted: Stage 3: on a freeze-stat trip, or when supply air temperature is below 38 °F for 15 minutes or below 34 °F for 5 minutes, the supply and return fans stop, the outdoor air dampers close, the cooling coil valve closes, the chilled water pumps are energized and a Level 2 alarm reports a freeze protection shutdown.
3.2.2: setpt variant planted: Heating resets the supply air temperature setpoint from 21.7 °C at 0 percent loop up to 54.4 °C at 50 percent loop.
3.3.1: interlock variant planted: The lead boiler is enabled at the same time as the lead hot water pump is commanded on.
3.5.3: paragraph left out of the submittal
3.4.2: alarm variant planted: Stage 2: when supply air temperature stays below 3.3 °C (38 °F) for 5 minutes, both outdoor air dampers close for 1 hour.
3.5.2: alarm variant planted: The supply and return duct smoke detectors are hardwired to stop both fans and close the outdoor air dampers; the BAS sets a Level 3 alarm on detection.
3.4.1: setpt variant planted: Trim and respond logic driven by cooling coil requests resets the chilled water supply temperature setpoint between 6.7 °C and 18.9 °C.
3.4.2: contra variant planted: When the plant enables, the chilled water supply temperature setpoint starts at 12.2 °C.
3.1.2: setpt variant planted: In deadband the fan runs at 5 percent, ramping to 100 percent as the heating or cooling loop goes from 50 to 100 percent.
3.1.1: setpt variant planted: The zone is held between 21.1 °C heating and 23.9 °C cooling when occupied, and between 10.0 °C heating and 29.4 °C cooling when unoccupied.
3.4.2: contra variant planted: In heating the outdoor air damper modulates above minimum to hold mixed air temperature at 12.8 °C.
3.2.13: setpt variant planted: VAV-612 is scheduled for 700 cfm cooling maximum, 80 cfm minimum and 350 cfm heating maximum.
3.3.3: contra variant planted: In the deadband the hot water valve modulates to keep the discharge air temperature at the zone temperature.
3.3.3: setpt variant planted: The minimum outdoor air damper modulates to hold the measured outdoor airflow at the 2700 cfm minimum setpoint.
3.3.4: contra variant planted: With the supply fan off, the outdoor air dampers and the return air damper are all closed.
3.1.1: contra variant planted: The fan cycles with heating or cooling demand in all modes, including Occupied.
3.3.2: contra variant planted: Another boiler stages on when the hot water supply temperature is 10 °F under setpoint for 10 minutes, whatever the firing rate of the running boilers.
3.5.1: interlock variant planted: Each boiler firing circuit includes the flow switch so the boiler cannot fire without proven flow.
3.4.4: interlock variant planted: After a freeze protection shutdown the unit restarts automatically once supply air temperature recovers.
3.5.3: setpt variant planted: The high static pressure safety switch, set at 1245 Pa, stops the supply fan, which then needs a manual reset to restart.
3.3.3: setpt variant planted: The chilled water valve is allowed to open only when outdoor air is warmer than 25 °F.
3.5.1: setpt variant planted: Tower fan speed modulates to hold condenser water supply temperature at 95 °F.
3.5.2: contra variant planted: Below 68 °F condenser water supply temperature the tower fans run at minimum speed and the tower bypass valve stays closed.
3.3.1: setpt variant planted: Occupied setpoints are 21.7 °C (71 °F) heating and 23.3 °C (74 °F) cooling, and unoccupied setpoints are 15.6 °C (60 °F) heating and 35.0 °C (95 °F) cooling.

3.2.2: contra variant planted: In the Occupied and Setup modes the supply air temperature setpoint is the maximum setpoint with outdoor air at 70 °F or warmer and falls linearly to 55 °F with outdoor air at 60 °F or cooler.
3.2.6: contra variant planted: As the loop output rises it opens the chilled water valve first, then modulates the outdoor and return air dampers, and finally strokes the heating coil valve closed.
3.1.2: setpt variant planted: Occupants may adjust the zone setpoints by at most 2.8 °C in either direction.
3.2.4: setpt variant planted: As the heating loop goes from 50 to 100 percent, supply fan speed rises from minimum to 100 percent.
3.5.2: interlock variant planted: The freeze-stat is hardwired to stop the supply fan and resets automatically when the coil warms up.
